source: Anthropic published per-model list pricing (claude-api skill, cached 2026-06-24). cache_write_5m is the standard 1.25x of base input; cache_read is the standard 0.1x of base input. cache_write_1h is set EQUAL to cache_write_5m rather than the nominal 2x, based on real archived Mother logs where cache_creation_input_tokens is billed at a single blended rate rather than split by the ephemeral_5m/1h TTL reported per-turn. Token buckets are still split and reported separately per the schema for observability; only the cost multiplier is unified. This is a narrow calibration of the cache-write tier only — it does NOT mean per-turn cost_usd reconciles tightly to the CLI's own costUSD overall; see CHANGELOG.md's 'Known limitation' section, which documents a separate, structural 20-55% undercount from output-token accounting.
